name: aquarium_landen_75

outer_dimensions_mm.source: Gavin brief 2026-11-07: LANDEN Amazon listing 37Gal W29.5×D17.7×H17.7 in (75x45x45cm); nominal, not tape measured

glass_thickness_mm.source: Gavin brief: UNCONFIRMED third-party LANDEN 75H listing; uniform panes assumed

near_inner_x_mm.source: docs/shackle-sim2real.md aquarium layout: wall at base back edge, 40 mm behind J1; arm extends toward -x

j1_y_from_inner_midline_mm.source: Gavin brief: J1 assumed centred across inner width; +y is left in this model

base_rpy_deg.source: Gavin brief: base/tank axes assumed aligned; long axis -x, width y, height z

floor_z_mm.source: Minimum z of all base_link collision-mesh vertices in configs/viscous/model/viscous_arm.urdf; assumes base directly on glass

base_spacer_height_mm.source: Gavin brief: assumes no mat/spacer; if measured height is h, floor_z_mm = base mesh minimum z - h

water_height_mm.source: docs/shackle-sim2real.md 2026-11-06/07 layout; height above inner glass floor, tank not filled; null disables

default_safety_margin_mm.source: Gavin aquarium brief 2026-11-07; future boundary design target

rim_z_mm.source: derived: placement.floor_z_mm + outer height - glass thickness; no physical lid

derived_inner_bounds_mm.source: derived from outer_dimensions_mm, glass_thickness_mm and placement; regenerate after measuring

arm.value: motor degrees directly to URDF radians
arm.source: Gavin brief and makermodslab/arm_gravity.py; no encoder offset or wrapping applied

gripper.source: Gavin brief: APPROXIMATE linear mapping, clamp to [0,52.4] mm per finger; URDF upper limit is 52.4125 mm

read.source: Gavin supplied read pose 2026-11-07; no hardware read performed by this model

folded.source: Gavin supplied Lab normal-teleop target with Star leader folded; offline target

unmodelled_obstacles: Black rim-clamped support tower near base: footprint and height unmeasured
Cables, fixtures, shackle and any mat/spacer are absent
